title: OpenAI Academy adds role-based paths for workers, developers and leaders
friendlyTitle: OpenAI adds free AI courses for different kinds of work
summary: OpenAI Academy now offers structured learning paths for everyday work, API and Codex development, organisational leadership, educators and college students. The courses emphasise practising on real tasks, reviewing outputs and adding human checkpoints, with assessments and completion badges.
friendlySummary: OpenAI Academy now has learning paths for office workers, developers, leaders, teachers and students. Learners practise real tasks and take assessments.
whyItMatters: The free curriculum gives organisations a practical starting point for AI literacy without treating every role as the same. Employers should pair vendor training with their own data rules, approved workflows and measures of actual work quality rather than counting badges alone.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Different jobs need different AI skills. The courses can help people start, but each organisation still needs its own rules for data, checking work and safe use.
